instruction: A flight leaves at 2025-03-10 22:40 local time in a UTC+8 zone and lasts 7 hours 25 minutes. What is the local date and time at arrival in a UTC-5 zone? Answer in the form YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM. Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to answer.txt.
